warnings: Grid bubbles are printed on S-01 (หน้า17): numbers 1-13 along x (12 bays x 4.00 = 48.00) and letters A-F along y. Origin A1 (top-left as drawn).

A/B and E/F are printed as two nearly coincident bubble pairs: A sits 0.125 outside B (outer chain A-C 3.625 vs inner chain B-C 3.50) and F sits 0.125 outside E (D-F 2.525 vs D-E 2.40). Columns and footings sit on B/C/D/E only; A and F carry no member on S-01 (outer wall-face lines). Both are kept as named lines because they are printed bubbles.

Conflict: the top plan prints the overall x dimension 48.00, the column/footing plan prints 47.98, and both print every bay as 4.00 (12 x 4.00 = 48.00). Taken: 48.00 — twelve printed bays plus one overall on the top plan beat one overall figure; the 47.98 row is kept in dimension_chains as printed.

The left vertical dimensions 4.00 and 1.50 (top) and 1.50 (bottom) were read at 400 dpi: their tick strokes sit at the outer lines A / F, not at the column lines B / E (0.125 apart). Taken: they hang off A and F (A' -4.00, A''' -1.50, F'' 11.15); if they actually hang off B/E every one of these three dummies shifts by 0.125 m. Same reading for S-02's cantilever-edge dimensions 1.00 (top, A'''' -1.00), 1.00 and 2.27 (bottom, F' 10.65 / F'''' 11.92), and S-03's eave 2.05 (A'' -2.05 / F''' 11.70).

B''' and C'' (the B1 beam lines at the third points of the 7.00 B-D bay, grids 2-12) are not dimensioned on S-01. Positioned by proportion (span amendment, section 4): B + 7.00/3 and B + 2 x 7.00/3; a pixel scan of the scan measured 2.36 and 4.66 m below B. They carry their own lower confidence_score.
B' (B + 2.00) and C'' (C + 2.15) are printed only in end bay 1-2; end bay 12-13 is drawn as its mirror (G2 / G2 / B4A / B2 on the same lines) and uses the same lines.

Sweep coverage (honest): this op04 run was cut short by a scheduled shutdown, so only S-01 (หน้า17) S-02 (หน้า18, floors 2 and 3) and S-03 (หน้า19, roof) were swept into this master. The elevations/sections (A-sheets) and S-02..S-10 have not been swept for further ticks or levels; z_levels holds only the +0.15 printed on S-01.
Footing-plan note printed under แปลนเสา ฐานราก: 'กรณีที่ใช้ฐานรากแผ่ สภาพชั้นดินต้องรับน้ำหนักได้ไม่น้อยกว่า 8,000 กก./ตรม.' (not a dimension).
